Due to a regulatory restriction, there is no permissible flight corridor directly connecting Node Alpha and Node Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to overlapping communication frequencies, exactly one of the following two flight links must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the link between Node Beta and Node Gamma, or the link between Node Gamma and Node Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal‑distance closed flight path that visits every node precisely once and returns to the origin node.
